english.note: Use this when loosely characterizing or estimating something rather than stating an exact fact.
Use this for judging that something qualifies as, or is regarded as, a particular type or quality.

examples.english: You can call this good news.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 syun3 hai6 hou2 siu1 sik1 laa3

examples.english: I count this as a solution.
examples.traditional: 我覺得呢個算係一個辦法喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 syun3 hai6 jat1 go3 baan6 faat3 laa3
